mapper.select: /* authsvc.repository.mybatis.mapper.UserMapper.findByUsrIdAndUsrPwd(로그인 조회 with Roles) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.USER_NM ,A.POSIT_DIV_NAME ,A.DEPT_NAME ,A.USER_PWD ,C.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS A INNER JOIN USER_ROLES B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN ROLES C ON B.ROLE_ID = C.ROLE_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{usrId} AND A.USER_PWD = #{usrPwd}

/* authsvc.repository.mybatis.mapper.UserMapper.findByUsrIdAndUsrPwd(리프레시 토큰으로 조회 with Roles) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.USER_NM ,A.POSIT_DIV_NAME ,A.DEPT_NAME ,A.USER_PWD ,C.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS A INNER JOIN USER_ROLES B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN ROLES C ON B.ROLE_ID = C.ROLE_ID WHERE A.REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken}
